name: Review Consumer
summary: Consumes deterministic review-state decisions derived from a current state and reviewer action.
description: Uses review.state-transition-decide to convert a current review state and reviewer decision into one governed next state. Needs explicit verify, reject, or keep-pending transitions without embedding persistence, notification, or workflow coordination inside the capability.

distinguished_from.how: Consumes review-state transitions such as verified or rejected, rather than the later decision to apply or not apply a proposal.
Needs reviewer-state transitions for governed review flows, rather than scored item classification outcomes.
